authorization: etymologise remaining Indo-Aryan surveys. do not rebuild. work autonomously and do what you can, you have 8 hours, i will review once your time is done.

proposals.evidence: Turner grāma explicitly gives Nepali gāũ, western Pahari grā̃/graũ, Gujarati gām and Marathi gāv village. These survey forms fit the corresponding regional village stems and inflectional vowels. Anomalous gʰoṛā̃ and velar-final gaŋ are excluded rather than assumed to have regular outcomes.

proposals.evidence: Turner āmra explicitly includes Nepali ā̃p, Gujarati/Marathi ā̃b/ā̃bā, Hindi ām and Sindhi āmī mango. These Terai, western and Haryana survey forms match the corresponding mango family, including the documented nasal-final ā̃p outcome. Compound answers and the distinct kairī family are excluded.
